world.title: 'We are not happy': Trump likely to fire Greece ambassador Guilfoyle after misconduct reports
world.summary: US President Donald Trump indicated he is considering firing Kimberly Guilfoyle, the US ambassador to Greece, following reports of her alleged improper and potentially illegal conduct during her time in Athens. Trump acknowledged the situation, stating he was “looking at” the matter. The allegations have raised concerns about her suitability for the ambassadorial position.

world.title: Live Updates: Latest from Israel, Iran, and the Middle East
world.summary: Iran has proposed to mediate between Saudi Arabia and the Houthi rebels. Pakistan has committed military support under a defense agreement. Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia condemned recent attacks on Riyadh. On February 28, Israel and the US initiated Operations Roaring Lion and Epic Fury, targeting Iran, resulting in the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

world.title: Elon Musk Quietly Becomes Biggest Known Donor To Help Republicans In Midterms
world.summary: Elon Musk has emerged as the largest known donor in the 2022 midterm elections, contributing over $276 million since July to support Republican candidates. This information was initially reported by the New York Times and later confirmed by Andrew Romeo, a spokesperson for Musk's super PAC. The donations aim to help maintain Republican majorities in Congress.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Before Going Into Trade On Oct 13
business.summary: On October 13, Indian benchmark indices, Sensex and Nifty 50, closed lower. The GIFT Nifty serves as an early indicator for market trends. Key stocks are highlighted, along with significant brokerage recommendations and a comprehensive trade setup. Investors are advised to stay informed about market movements and brokerage insights before making trading decisions.

business.title: India’s telecom equipment market could double to $50 Bn: 3 stocks making 5G gear
business.summary: India’s telecom equipment market is projected to double to $50 billion by FY32, driven by growth in 5G manufacturing. Companies such as HFCL and Tejas Networks are increasing production and obtaining global orders, despite differing financial results. This trend indicates India’s strengthening role as a manufacturing hub for 5G equipment, as highlighted at the India Mobile Congress 2026.

business.title: 2 SME moves: Mukul Agrawal’s new defence bet, Ashish Kacholia’s bigger Kavach stake
business.summary: Mukul Agrawal has invested in an aerospace parts manufacturer, which has increased fivefold since its IPO. Meanwhile, Ashish Kacholia has raised his stake in a railway safety electronics supplier from 1.18% to 1.64%. This move comes as the stock trades 20% below its peak. Both investors are pursuing different strategies in the SME market.

technology.title: vivo launches S2 FE with 10,000 mAh battery
technology.summary: Vivo has launched the S2 FE smartphone in Hyderabad, targeting the needs of India's trendy, always-connected youth. The device features a substantial 10,000 mAh battery, designed to keep users powered throughout their day. The S2 FE aims to enhance social connectivity and cater to the demands of modern users, showcasing a blend of functionality and style.

technology.title: CMF launches Speaker S and Speaker M, its first speakers
technology.summary: CMF by Nothing has introduced its first portable Bluetooth speakers, the Speaker S priced at $59 and the Speaker M at $109. This launch marks CMF's transition into a standalone subsidiary based in India. The company aims to expand its product offerings while establishing a budget-friendly brand identity in the competitive audio market.

technology.title: 7 best practices when using recruitment chatbots in the age of AI
technology.summary: Recruitment chatbots can assist with tasks like scheduling interviews, but CHROs should implement best practices to ensure effective use. Precautions are necessary to prevent chatbots from providing incorrect responses or making significant errors. Teams should be trained to monitor chatbot interactions, update responses regularly, and maintain a human touch in communication to enhance candidate experience and mitigate risks.

sports.title: Akriti Agarwal Says She Was 'Misguided', Reunites With Prithvi Shaw Weeks After Calling Off Engagement
sports.summary: Akriti Agarwal and cricketer Prithvi Shaw have reconciled weeks after calling off their engagement. In an Instagram post titled 'A Personal Clarification', Agarwal expressed that she was "misguided" by the opinions of those close to her, which affected her perception of their relationship. She acknowledged that these influences led her to reconsider her feelings towards Shaw.

sports.title: MotoGP title fight: Aprilia’s first 1-2-3-4 result but Márquez is the real winner
sports.summary: At Mandalika, Aprilia achieved its first 1-2-3-4 result, but Marc Márquez maintained his championship lead despite not gaining points. Jorge Martin, expected to increase his score, ended up with the same points as Márquez. Additionally, riders Acosta and Márquez criticized Liberty for imposing fines on those who miss promotional activities, highlighting ongoing tensions in the MotoGP.

sports.title: Hansi Flick talks Gabriel Jesus, Vinicius Jr and Galatasaray ahead of Champions League tie
sports.summary: Barcelona's manager Hansi Flick discussed key players Gabriel Jesus and Vinicius Jr. ahead of the upcoming Champions League match against Galatasaray. He emphasized the importance of respect in interactions with fans and contributors. The club's community guidelines highlight the need for respectful behavior, warning against trolling and disruptive actions, particularly towards rival teams.

health.title: Nanobubbles could make pharmaceutical manufacturing much more efficient and cleaner, says new IIT Ropar study
health.summary: A study from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Ropar has introduced a sustainable method for controlling the crystallisation of essential medicines. This technique involves infusing liquids with nanobubbles, which are microscopic and not visible to the naked eye. The research aims to enhance the efficiency and cleanliness of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, potentially transforming industry practices.

health.title: Gout Disease Symptoms & Prevention: Men Health Tips
health.summary: Gout, historically known as a "disease of kings," is increasingly prevalent globally, particularly among men. While often linked to diet and alcohol, medical experts emphasize that gout's causes are multifaceted. Early warning signs and preventive measures are crucial for management. Health updates and tips for men regarding gout symptoms and prevention are currently being highlighted by medical professionals.

health.title: High BP Risk Factors; Blood Pressure (Hypertension) Symptoms & Treatment
health.summary: High blood pressure (hypertension) significantly increases the risk of heart disease, heart attacks, and strokes. Common risk factors include high cholesterol, obesity, and diabetes. Recognizing symptoms is crucial for management. Effective treatment options are available to control blood pressure, which can help prevent serious medical emergencies. Staying informed about hypertension is essential for maintaining cardiovascular health.

science.title: ESA Solar Orbiter traces S-shaped switchbacks to magnetic loops
science.summary: The European Space Agency's Solar Orbiter has traced the source of S-shaped magnetic switchbacks on the Sun, enhancing understanding of solar wind formation and space weather prediction. These switchbacks, filled with charged particles such as oxygen and carbon, appear to originate in hot magnetic loops. This discovery contributes to solving solar mysteries and improving predictions related to space weather.

science.title: Strong Magnetic Fields Could Allow White Dwarfs To Grow Beyond The Chandrasekhar Limit
science.summary: Research from IISc indicates that strong internal magnetic fields in carbon-oxygen white dwarfs may enable them to surpass the Chandrasekhar limit of approximately 1.4 solar masses. Simulations suggest these stars could reach about 2.4 solar masses under certain conditions. This finding could enhance understanding of stellar evolution and the behavior of dense stellar remnants in the universe.

science.title: TriAlign UDA for hybrid domain adaptation of frozen histopathology foundation model representations
science.summary: The study introduces TriAlign-UDA, a hybrid unsupervised domain adaptation framework for histopathology images, addressing domain shifts without encoder fine-tuning. It combines statistical alignment, prototype-based semantic preservation, and adversarial adaptation. Using datasets NCT-CRC-HE-100K, TCGA-COAD/READ, and CRC-VAL-HE-7K, TriAlign-UDA achieved a mean accuracy of 0.9669, outperforming other methods, though differences with competitors were not statistically significant.
